steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); window.__gitgood.actions.setView('history'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const commits = window.__gitgood.store.get().history.commits; const sha = commits[0].sha; window.__gitgood.actions.selectCommit(sha); await window.__gitgood.actions.loadCommitDetails(sha); window.__gitgood.actions.explainCommit(sha); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && window.__gitgood.store.get().explain.loading; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); const e = s.explain; return JSON.stringify({ open: e.open, error: e.error, whatChanged: e.result ? e.result.whatChanged : null, why: e.result ? e.result.why : null, impact: e.result ? e.result.impact : null, watchOutForCount: e.result ? e.result.watchOutFor.length : 0, referencesCount: e.result ? e.result.references.length : 0, droppedReferences: e.result ? e.result.droppedReferences : null }); })()
